# INEAN PLAY OKEY & Mahjong Printables

Free original static PDF forms for handwriting. They record agreed rules and scores; they do not calculate game results. Languages: en, zh, tr, de. Each five-page pack covers table agreement, OKEY scores, Mahjong points and optional pool, seating, and external care.
